facts.text: Report holder THE MURUS COMPANY; subject is Murus PUR SIPs with a foamed-in-place polyurethane core.
Used as structural insulated roof and wall panels; combustible for construction type under IBC Chapter 6.
'Murus PUR SIPs shall not be used as part of a fire-rated assembly unless suitable evidence and details are submitted and approved by the authority having jurisdiction.'
Shear-wall configurations in Table 5 are limited to Seismic Design Categories A, B and C.

Installation complies with the report and approved construction documents; thicknesses listed only; no span extrapolation; production at Mansfield, Pennsylvania under ICC-ES-inspected quality control.
Evidence listed: axial, transverse and in-plane racking shear tests 'conducted in accordance with general guidelines of ASTM E72'.
